Welcome To Directorate of Sports

The Department of Physical Education and Sports focusing on “A Sound Mind in a Sound Body” through promotion of healthy life style in the Society. Its envision to become a Centre of advanced Research, Fitness and Recreation a leading body in Physical Education and Sports in the Province.
MISSION:
The Mission of the Department of Physical education and sports is to inculcate on students the advanced physical education knowledge, practical analytical skills and excellent research ethics for employment in the field of sports, private organizations, and public sector academic organizations and to prepare the students for the pursuit of higher education.

home (https://awkum.edu.pk)

Who we are?

Soon after the establishment of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, several departments were made functional. Likewise, the Department of Physical education was established due to the keen desire expressed by various sections of the society.

The primary aim of the Department of Physical Education & Sports is to produce best physical Educationists. The reason behind this is the importance of public health and general fitness. The public being aware of the importance of this discipline raise voice for trained teachers in their schools, colleges and other institutions. The Department was made functional to meet the needs of trained physical educationists across the region.

Quality in Physical Education is the top priority of this Department because in past there was extreme shortage of standard institutions in the field of the physical education. The Department of Physical Education & Sports will provide services to the sports personal and will train teachers, coaches, trainers and sports organizers; who will not only equipped with latest knowledge in physical education but will also willing to apply their knowledge into their respective fields in order to bring positive changes in the society.

Practice makes perfect

We know about your hectic schedule. We also know the only way you truly understand a subject is by practicing it in a real environment. This is why we’ve set a playground area that’s full of hours of exercises, questions and challenges. It even has a gaming section.

The best campus facilities

In addition to our online classroom, we also offer an option to take part in a live classroom. It takes place in our vast campuses. Here you’ll be able to use the most up-to-date facilities and computer equipment.
